1	def save(store, workspace, operation_id, values):

3	                   if item["workspace"] == workspace), None)

6	                  "status": "pending", "values": dict(values)}
7	        store.recovery[operation_id] = record
8	    if record["status"] == "pending":
9	        store.apply(workspace, record["values"])
10	        record["status"] = "applied"
11	    store.receipt(record)
